_readme: Estimated pay for postings that publish no range. These are NOT market data
and NOT an employer's offer - they are model estimates from title, employer,
location and description, and they are labelled 'estimate' everywhere they
are used. They are deliberately never written into postings.salary_max,
Method: frontier-model estimate against comparable public roles, 2026-09-27.
confidence: high = anchored on a real posted range for a near-identical role
or on a kit ask whose basis was the top of a posted range;
low = little to anchor on, treat as a wide hint only.
Tiering uses the MIDPOINT. Any range whose low and high fall in different
pay tiers is marked 'straddles' and downgraded to 'maybe' in pursuit(),
because a wrong estimate must not silently decide whether Jordan applies.
Delete an entry to force a re-estimate.
